name: BT Quote
changelog: v0.1.0 — Initial release. Pricing engine (print + embroidery) and quote submission ported from WPCode snippets into the plugin. Drop-in: serves POST /wp-json/boomerts/v1/price and /quote with identical formulas and response shapes (5,946-case parity verified). Reusable PHP API (btq_price) for catalog/portal/checkout integration. GitHub auto-update.
